BiblicalUsage: Of the tribe of Naphtali, Nahbi the son of Vophsi was sent to spy out the land. His father Vophsi is named only here, as the father of the spy.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the spies are named father by father because the mission was personal: Vophsi's son carried his father's name into Canaan, and the report he brought back shaped a generation.
